title: Hexa Clear Puzzle
description: Fit jewel-like hexagonal block clusters onto a honeycomb board to wipe complete lines in three directions and ignite blazing combo streaks.
controls: Drag hexagonal shapes from the tray onto open cells to complete full lines across any of the three axes.

zh-CN.title: 六边形消除
zh-CN.description: 烧脑解压蜂巢消除六边形消除：拖动多彩六边形拼块填满任意方向一整条直线瞬间清屏，手感丝滑无比！
zh-CN.controls: 将下方六边形组合拖入蜂巢盘面，沿任意三个方向填满整排即可触发消除。
